mainEntity.name: How much does professional surface preparation add to the cost of a painting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional surface preparation can significantly impact the overall cost, typically ranging from 15% to 40% of the total painting project expense. This percentage varies based on the surface's initial condition; extensive repairs, power washing, scraping, sanding, and multiple priming coats will increase the cost. While it adds to the upfront investment, thorough preparation is crucial for a lasting finish and reduces the likelihood of costly premature failures, making it a valuable part of the budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional surface preparation can add 15% to 40% to painting project costs, depending on the surface condition and required work, but it's essential for a durable finish.
